# Wordwall

> Wordwall is an interactive learning platform that enables teachers and educators to create engaging educational activities, games, and printable worksheets for classroom instruction.

Wordwall provides a comprehensive suite of customizable templates for creating interactive learning experiences across language learning, phonics, reading comprehension, and general educational activities. The platform supports multiple subscription tiers and serves educators looking to enhance student engagement through gamified and interactive exercises.

## Key Topics

- Interactive learning
- Language learning
- Classroom activities
- Educational games
- Phonics instruction
- Drag-and-drop exercises
- Reading comprehension
- Sight words
- Teacher resources
- ESL/English language learning
- Interactive templates
- Educational worksheets
- Grammar practice
- Vocabulary exercises
- Student engagement

## Getting Started

- [Wordwall Homepage](https://wordwall.net): Wordwall homepage: create interactive activities and printable worksheets.
- [Sign up](https://wordwall.net/account/basicsignup): Sign up for a free Basic Wordwall account with registration.
- [Price plans](https://wordwall.net/price-plans): Compare Wordwall Basic, Standard, and Pro subscription plans.

## Activity Templates

- [Quiz](https://wordwall.net/about/template/quiz): Quiz template: multiple choice questions for interactive learning.
- [Flash cards](https://wordwall.net/about/template/flash-cards): Flashcard template for vocabulary and language learning practice.
- [Matching pairs](https://wordwall.net/about/template/matching-pairs): Matching pairs memory game template for language learning.
- [Match up](https://wordwall.net/about/template/match-up): Match-up template: drag keywords next to definitions.
- [Find the match](https://wordwall.net/about/template/find-the-match): Find-the-match template for interactive matching activities.
- [Group sort](https://wordwall.net/about/template/group-sort): Group sort template: drag items into correct groups.
- [Complete the sentence](https://wordwall.net/about/template/complete-the-sentence): Cloze activity template for sentence completion exercises.
- [Anagram](https://wordwall.net/about/template/anagram): Anagram template for word unscrambling and spelling practice.
- [Unjumble](https://wordwall.net/about/template/unjumble): Unjumble template for sentence ordering and grammar practice.
- [Spin the wheel](https://wordwall.net/about/template/spin-the-wheel): Spin-the-wheel template for interactive classroom activities.
- [Speaking cards](https://wordwall.net/about/template/speaking-cards): Speaking cards template for phonics and language learning.
- [Open the box](https://wordwall.net/about/template/open-the-box): Open-the-box template for interactive educational activities.
